_comment: Single source of truth for the pinned OpenCascade artifact. occ:install and occ:provision verify against it (scripts/occProvision.mjs); the version-consistency test reads it. The registry integrity is the npm packument's dist.integrity for the exact version and is what npm itself checks at install; the sha256 digests pin the two files as installed, so provisioning refuses bytes that did not come from that tarball.
